description: This file defines API handlers for managing shared channels and remote clusters in Mattermost, including functions for retrieving shared channels, remote cluster info, managing remote cluster invitations, and checking user permissions for direct messaging.

methods.name: getSharedChannels
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to retrieve shared channels for a team, with permission checks and JSON response.

methods.name: getRemoteClusterInfo
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to retrieve information about a remote cluster for the current user.

methods.name: getSharedChannelRemotesByRemoteCluster
methods.description: Retrieves shared channel remotes filtered by remote cluster ID.

methods.name: inviteRemoteClusterToChannel
methods.description: Handles invitation of a remote cluster to a channel, with permission and validation checks.

methods.name: uninviteRemoteClusterToChannel
methods.description: Handles removal of a remote cluster from a channel, with permission and validation checks.

methods.name: getSharedChannelRemotes
methods.description: Retrieves remote clusters associated with a shared channel.

methods.name: canUserDirectMessage
methods.description: Checks if a user can directly message another user, considering remote cluster connections.
